open_points.subject: HTTP method closed set ownership (`ManifestOperation.http_method` / A08 rule 3)
open_points.text: "Closed sets that are a model's — classes, statuses, HTTP methods — are `models` enumerations" and "models ... with their closed status and class enumerations."
open_points.question: Where is the authoritative closed set of allowed HTTP methods (`GET|POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE`) owned: as a `models` enumeration or elsewhere?
options: Own it in `models` as an HTTP-method enum consumed by `bindings` and `service_invoker`
Own it in `data_provider` as constants consumed by `bindings`/`service_invoker`
Own it inside `bindings` (with `service_invoker` treating methods opaquely)
open_points.default_guess: Own it in `models` as an enumeration, because State 3 explicitly classifies HTTP methods as a model closed set.

open_points.subject: Startup spool cleanup responsibility (A18 rule 4)
open_points.text: State 2 A18 rule 4: "On start, temporary files and the spool directories of runs that ended and do not keep their spool (A14) are removed; nothing else is." vs State 3: "`store.open_store`, which ... removes temporary files" and "`runs.recover_running_runs`, which first names to `store.remove_run_spool` every ended run that no longer keeps its spool".
open_points.question: At startup, which module is responsible for determining and performing removal of ended-run spools: `store` internally during `open_store`, or `runs` via explicit `remove_run_spool` calls?
options: `store.open_store` both determines eligibility and removes spools
`runs` determines eligibility; `store` only performs removals it is told
Hybrid: `store` does baseline cleanup, `runs` does policy-based spool removals
open_points.default_guess: `runs` determines which spools are eligible and calls `store.remove_run_spool`, with `store.open_store` limited to generic temp-file cleanup.
